battle.name: 波蘭戰役
battle.brief: 1939年9月1日德軍自北、西、南三面越境，9月17日蘇聯自東面進軍，波蘭國防軍在三十六天內崩潰。卡面的1860年美國加特林機槍是速射機槍的老祖宗，波蘭是少數仍保有這種武器的歐洲國家之一，但真正左右戰局的是Maxim wz. 1910通用機槍與德軍俯衝轟炸機群。

kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 這場戰爭是1939年9月1日至10月6日之間，波蘭共和國與德國、蘇聯之間的一場國家存亡之戰，交戰各方從頭到尾都沒有正式宣戰，德軍是以「白色方案」這場軍事行動直接開打。波蘭方面由總司令元帥愛德華·雷茲-斯米格維坐鎮華沙總參謀部，參謀總長瓦迪斯瓦夫·拉吉尼斯與主管軍事作戰的副參謀總長卡齊米日·索斯尼科夫分掌策劃；全軍約一百萬人，以三十九個師與十個旅為骨幹，分屬七個方面軍及數個集群部隊，首都另設守備司令部，並在九月十二日成軍的「首都防衛司令部」統一節制。波蘭政府直到戰局崩壞之後才遷往國外，戰前線完全由本土指揮部自行運作。德國方面由國防軍最高統帥部統籌，分北、中、南三個戰役集群：北方集群由法爾肯霍斯特率領，中央方面以魯登施泰特為總指揮，第四軍團由克盧格、第五軍由賴歇瑙率領，南面則是沃伊爾什指揮的南方集群自斯洛伐克方向翻越喀爾巴阡山。蘇聯依據1939年8月23日《蘇德互不侵犯條約》及其秘密附加議定書，於9月17日自東面進軍，實際指揮權分屬白俄羅斯方面軍與北方面軍，另有內務人民委員部部隊配合。英法兩國在9月3日對德宣戰，卻沒有向波蘭派出地面部隊；義大利未參戰，匈牙利與羅馬尼亞則接收了波蘭的流亡軍官、士兵與船隻。
countriesEn: This war was fought between the Polish Republic and Germany and the Soviet Union from 1 September to 6 October 1939, a struggle for the survival of the state in which none of the belligerents ever issued a formal declaration of war; the Germans simply opened the campaign as a military operation, Fall Weiss. On the Polish side the commander-in-chief, Marshal Edward Rydz-Śmigły, sat in the General Staff in Warsaw, with Chief of Staff Władysław Raginis and the deputy chief of staff for military operations Kazimierz Sosnkowski dividing the planning; the army numbered about one million men, its backbone being thirty-nine divisions and ten brigades distributed over seven armies and several group formations, with a separate garrison command for the capital and a Defence of the Capital staff formed on 12 September to unify control. The Polish government moved abroad only after the front had already collapsed, and the fighting was run entirely by the domestic command. On the German side the campaign was run by the OKH and divided into a northern, a central and a southern army group: the Army Group North was led by Nikolaus von Falkenhorst, the centre was under Gerd von Rundstedt with the Fourth Army under Günther von Kluge and the Fifth Army under Gerd von Reichenau, while in the south Woyrsch's Army Group South came over the Carpathians from Slovakia. The Soviet Union, acting on the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact of 23 August 1939 and its secret additional protocol, entered from the east on 17 September, the operational command divided between the Belorussian Front and the North-Western Front, with units of the NKVD cooperating. Britain and France declared war on Germany on 3 September but sent no ground troops to Poland; Italy did not take part, while Hungary and Romania received Polish officers, soldiers and ships in exile.
people: 決定這場戰役走向的人物分屬三個陣營。波蘭方面，總司令雷茲-斯米格維在戰局崩壞時把指揮權交給索斯尼科夫，退入隱匿，10月27日被蓋世太保在維希涅瓦附近捉獲，1941年在華沙病逝；參謀總長拉吉尼斯在華沙淪陷前後以性命拒絕被俘。首都防衛由波尼亞托夫斯基接管，他與守備司令朗格納、防衛司令達貝克共同撐住華沙到9月27日；第1軍軍長博爾特諾夫斯基在淪陷後接掌流亡軍總參謀部，第10摩托化騎兵旅旅長安德斯於9月10日在莫克拉一役以騎兵反擊重創德軍裝甲師本人，戰後在西方組成「安德斯軍」並成為波蘭流亡陸軍總司令；第13步兵師師長卡萬科夫斯基死守克帕奧克塞夫斯卡，第1師團師長斯莫拉文斯基守衛韋斯特普拉特，赫爾半島則由扎博羅夫斯基將軍統一指揮。空軍方面，戰鬥航空隊的斯特凡·巴托里率「坎皮諾斯」大隊作戰，維托爾德·烏爾巴諾維奇與斯坦尼斯瓦夫·斯卡爾斯基是最著名的波蘭王牌。德國方面，元首希特勒主持「白色方案」，凱特爾掌最高統帥部，魯登施泰特與博克分任中央與北方戰役集群指揮，古德里安率裝甲集群在布祖拉河作戰，埃里希·馮·德姆·巴赫與保羅·豪塞指揮摩托化師與黨衛軍「死亡師團」投入莫克拉方向。蘇聯方面，莫洛托夫代表政府宣布進軍，季莫申科與什捷爾分任兩大方面軍司令，內務人民委員貝利亞直接督導東線的接管與清剿。
peopleEn: The personalities who decided the course of this war came from three camps. On the Polish side the commander-in-chief Rydz-Śmigły handed over command to Sosnkowski as the front collapsed, went into hiding, and was taken by the Gestapo near Wiśniewa on 27 October, dying in Warsaw in 1941; the chief of staff Raginis refused to be captured with his own life in the days around the fall of Warsaw. The defence of the capital was taken over by Poniatowski, who together with the garrison commander Langner and the defence commander Dąbek held Warsaw until 27 September; the commander of the First Army, Bortnowski, took over the General Staff of the army in exile after the collapse, and Władysław Anders, commander of the 10th Motorized Cavalry Brigade, struck the German armoured corps hard at Mokra on 10 September with a mounted counter-attack, later forming the Anders Army in the West and becoming commander-in-chief of the Polish army in exile; Aleksander Kawańkowski of the 13th Infantry Division held Kępa Oksywska, Mieczysław Smorawiński of the 1st Infantry Regiment defended Westerplatte, and the Hel peninsula was unified under General Władysław Zaborowski. In the air, Stefan Batory of the Fighter Aviation led the Kampinos group, and Witold Urbanowicz and Stanisław Skalski were the best known of the Polish aces. On the German side Hitler directed Fall Weiss, Keitel held the OKH, Rundstedt and Bock commanded the central and northern army groups, Guderian led the Panzergruppe on the Bzura, and Erich von dem Bach-Zelewski and Paul Hausser fed the motorized divisions and the SS Totenkopf into the Mokra sector. On the Soviet side Molotov announced the intervention for his government, Timoshenko and Shtern commanded the two fronts, and Beria as head of the NKVD directly supervised the takeover and the liquidation in the east.
kits: 卡面上的1860年美國加特林機槍是速射機槍的老祖宗：理查德·喬丹·加特林1860年完成多管人力手搖結構，1861年成為美軍制式武器，內戰、西班牙-美國戰爭、菲律賓-美國戰爭與義和團事變都大量使用，直到上世紀二十年代才逐步退出一線，最後由菲律賓與少數地方武裝用到二次大戰初期。波蘭是歐洲少數始終沒有把它徹底淘汰的國家，1939年9月仍有少量7.65毫米口徑的加特林式速射機槍留在裝備表上，多配於海防固定陣位、港灣守備與後方警衛，真正投入交火的則是它的技術後裔Maxim通用機槍。波軍步兵師配7.65毫米Maxim wz. 1910水冷式重機槍，每槍備彈約一千發、每分鐘射速約五百發，另有法製Browning M1917輕機槍、Hotchkiss wz. 1929輕機槍與早期進口的8毫米Hotchkiss wz. 1914；反戰車有37毫米Bofors wz. 37、7.92毫米wz. 35步槍改裝的「圖羅夫斯基」戰鬥步槍與25毫米反戰車砲；砲兵以老舊的75毫米wz. 1897野戰砲為骨架，另有105毫米與150毫米榴彈砲、81毫米wz. 36迫擊砲、高射砲與探照燈。海軍驅逐艦裝40毫米Bofors速射砲、13.2毫米Hotchkiss砲與7.65毫米Maxim機槍，潛艇以小口徑機槍與水雷為主。德軍的火力骨架則是7.92毫米MG08/15、MG13與新式MG34重機槍、MP40衝鋒槍，裝甲配3.7厘米PaK 36與5厘米PaK 38反戰車砲、7.5厘米PaK 88野戰砲與10.5厘米leFH 18榴彈砲，空中有Ju 87俯衝轟炸機、Ju 88與Do 17。兩軍的汽車運輸都極不充足，波軍靠徵用民車與馬車車隊維持補給線，德軍同樣大量使用雙馬挽具。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun of 1860 shown on the card is the ancestor of the rapid-fire machine gun: Richard Jordan Gatling completed the multi-barrel hand-cranked design in 1860, it became standard US Army equipment in 1861, and it was used in quantity in the Civil War, the Spanish-American War, the Philippine-American War and the Boxer Rebellion, only fading from the front line in the 1920s and surviving in Philippine and local hands into the opening years of the Second World War. Poland was one of the few European states that never scrapped it completely; in September 1939 a small number of 7.65 millimetre Gatling-type guns were still on the Polish establishment, mostly in coastal fixed positions, harbour defence and rear-area security, and the weapon that actually fought was the Maxim, its technical descendant. Polish infantry divisions carried the 7.65 millimetre Maxim wz. 1910 water-cooled heavy machine gun, with about one thousand rounds per gun and a rate of fire of some five hundred rounds a minute, together with French-made Browning M1917 light machine guns, Hotchkiss wz. 1929 light machine guns and the earlier imported 8 millimetre Hotchkiss wz. 1914; for anti-tank work there were the 37 millimetre Bofors wz. 37, the Turowski combat rifle converted from the 7.92 millimetre wz. 35 and a 25 millimetre anti-tank gun. The artillery backbone was the old 75 millimetre wz. 1897 field gun, with 105 and 150 millimetre howitzers, 81 millimetre wz. 36 mortars, antiaircraft guns and searchlights. Polish destroyers mounted 40 millimetre Bofors pom-poms, 13.2 millimetre Hotchkiss guns and 7.65 millimetre Maxim machine guns, while submarines relied on small-calibre machine guns and mines. The German firepower skeleton was the 7.92 millimetre MG08/15, MG13 and the new MG34 heavy machine gun together with the MP40, the armoured formations carried 3.7 cm PaK 36 and 5 cm PaK 38 anti-tank guns, 7.5 cm PaK 88 field guns and 10.5 cm leFH 18 howitzers, and the air arm had the Ju 87 dive bomber, the Ju 88 and the Do 17. Motor transport was scarce on both sides: the Polish ran its supply columns on requisitioned civilian lorries and horse-drawn wagons, and the Germans leaned equally on two-horse teams.
tactics: 德軍的戰法圍繞「白色方案」的殲滅戰構思展開：空軍先在9月1日至3日以大規模空襲摧毀波蘭空軍停在場上的數百架飛機，切斷鐵路樞紐，再以Ju 87俯衝轟炸機掩護裝甲部隊突破；北路沿鐵路軸線自波美拉尼亞南下，中央集團以3.7與5厘米砲在寬正面撕開缺口，南方集群在喀爾巴阡山口實施壓倒性突破，三個矛頭最後在華沙以西合圍。裝甲師依賴道路行軍，推進速度被泥濘與拉長的縱隊拖累；波軍的抵抗集中在預設陣地與國防工事線上，以梯次阻擊換取時間，等待英法援助到來。波軍也發動了代價高昂的反擊：9月7日起第十摩托化騎兵旅與第1、第14、第15步兵師在布祖拉河沿岸合擊德軍第1、第2裝甲師，德軍第十九軍團隨即集中兩個裝甲師回擊，把波軍數個師反包在坎皮諾斯沼澤邊緣，一度被俘約四千人。9月10日安德斯的騎兵旅在莫克拉迎擊德軍戰車團，以馬匹機動配合反戰車砲，擊毀或擊傷德軍約五十輛戰車。華沙防線是逐街的巷戰：9月8日起守軍以路障與街壘抵抗，到9月27日城破。赫爾半島與韋斯特普拉特是延續抵抗的兩個點，守軍利用要塞砲與灘頭工事把德軍拖到十月初。海戰方面，波蘭海軍在維斯瓦灣佈雷，驅逐艦「雷霆」號與「閃電」號以魚雷與砲火襲擊德軍登岸部隊，「暴風」號在9月30日於赫爾外海擊沉德軍魚雷艇T196，「疾風」號則在9月20日砲擊赫爾半島上的德軍陣地。
tacticsEn: German method was built around the annihilating logic of Fall Weiss. The air force first destroyed the hundreds of Polish aircraft parked on their airfields with mass raids on 1 to 3 September, cut the railway junctions, and then covered the armoured breakthrough with Ju 87 dive bombers; the northern thrust ran down the railway axis from Pomerania, the central group tore open a wide front with 3.7 and 5 cm guns, and the southern group made an overwhelming break through the Carpathian passes, the three prongs finally closing west of Warsaw. Armoured divisions moved by road, so mud and lengthened columns held the advance down. Polish resistance was concentrated on prepared positions and fortification lines, buying time in successive blocking actions in the hope of help from Britain and France. Poland also launched costly counter-offensives: from 7 September the 10th Motorized Cavalry Brigade and the 1st, 14th and 15th Infantry Divisions struck the German 1st and 2nd Panzer Divisions on the Bzura, and the German XIX Corps promptly counter-attacked with two panzer divisions, entrapping several Polish divisions at the edge of the Kampinos marshes and taking about four thousand prisoners. On 10 September Anders's cavalry brigade met the German tank corps at Mokra and, combining horse mobility with anti-tank guns, destroyed or disabled about fifty German tanks. The defence of Warsaw was a street-by-street fight: from 8 September the garrison held with barricades and street obstacles until the city fell on 27 September. The Hel peninsula and Westerplatte were the two points of continued resistance, where the garrisons used fortress guns and beach positions to hold the Germans until early October. At sea the Polish navy mined the Vistula Bay, the destroyers Grom and Błyskawica torpedoed and shelled the German beachheads, Burza sank the German torpedo boat T196 off Hel on 30 September, and Wicher shelled German positions on the peninsula on 20 September.
data: 可核對的數字：時間上，自9月1日開打到10月6日停火，歷時三十六天。兵力上，波蘭總兵力約一百萬人，編有三十九個師與十個旅，坦克約八百八十輛，其中三百八十餘輛是法製FT-17與R-35輕坦，作戰飛機約四百架；德軍投入約一百五十萬人、六十餘個師，坦克約二千七百五十至三千輛，飛機約二千四百至二千六百架；蘇軍9月17日投入的兵員逾六十萬，坦克數千輛但作戰半徑有限。損失上，波軍陣亡約六萬六千至七萬人、受傷約十三萬三千人、被俘約六十九萬四千餘人；德軍陣亡約一萬六千餘人、受傷約三萬人；蘇軍陣亡約千人、受傷約三千人。節點上，波蘭空軍在9月2日即基本喪失作戰能力，開戰三天內損失飛機約三百架；德軍在西里西亞空降奇襲，奪取卡托維茲機場與軍火庫；華沙圍城自9月8日至27日，最後城內守軍與起義部隊多數被俘。波軍赫爾守軍約二千餘人堅持到十月初，島上居民乘漁船與登陸艇撤往格但斯克，人數以萬計；約四萬名波蘭海軍人員與三十六艘軍艦撤往英國，另有上萬名軍政人員經羅馬尼亞中轉撤往法國。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are as follows. In time, the fighting ran from 1 September to the ceasefire of 6 October, thirty-six days. In manpower, Poland had about one million men in thirty-nine divisions and ten brigades, about eight hundred and eighty tanks of which more than three hundred and eighty were French FT-17 and R-35 light tanks, and about four hundred combat aircraft; Germany committed roughly one and a half million men in more than sixty divisions, about two thousand seven hundred and fifty to three thousand tanks and some two thousand four hundred to two thousand six hundred aircraft; the Soviet Union put more than six hundred thousand men into the field on 17 September with thousands of tanks, though its reach was limited. In losses, the Polish army had about sixty-six to seventy thousand dead, about one hundred and thirty-three thousand wounded and about six hundred and ninety-four thousand prisoners; the Germans about sixteen thousand dead and thirty thousand wounded; the Soviets about a thousand dead and three thousand wounded. At the turning points, the Polish air force had essentially ceased to function by 2 September, losing some three hundred aircraft in the first three days; German airborne troops made a surprise landing in Silesia, seizing the Katowice airfield and its magazines; the siege of Warsaw ran from 8 to 27 September, most of the garrison and the improvised rising groups being taken prisoner. The Hel garrison of about two thousand men held into early October, and the island population was evacuated to Gdańsk by fishing boats and landing craft in numbers running into the tens of thousands; about forty thousand Polish naval personnel and thirty-six warships reached Britain, while more than ten thousand officers and men were moved to France through Romania as an intermediate stop.
cause: 遠因是凡爾賽和約對德國的束縛與波蘭在東歐的位置。波蘭重建時被劃出一條通往波羅的海的走廊，使德國本土與但澤自由市被隔開；德國以民族自決與少數民族受迫害為由，要求收回但澤、拆毀走廊，奧得河上游的德意志居民問題被一再用作宣傳素材。1938年《慕尼黑協定》把蘇台德地區割讓給德國，1939年3月德國吞併捷克斯洛伐克並成立波希米亞和摩拉瓦保護國，隨後在斯洛伐克扶植一個依附德國的衛星國。3月28日德國與斯洛伐克簽訂的條約更埋下德國在波蘭一旦動用武力的「選擇權」；3月31日法英分別遞交保證波蘭獨立的照會，4月英國單獨作出保證，5月12日法波軍事公約簽訂，法國承諾在波蘭遭攻擊後短期內出兵。蘇聯則以波蘭走廊與波蘭在東歐的戰略利益為由，8月23日與德國簽訂《蘇德互不侵犯條約》，秘密附加議定書劃定了德蘇在東歐的分界，波蘭幾乎被從地圖上抹去；英法與蘇聯在四月至八月間的談判破裂，波蘭因此只得到西方保證而沒有東方承諾。直接導火線是格萊維茨電台事件的偽造藉口，9月1日凌晨德軍開火，砲擊韋斯特普拉特並越過邊界，波蘭隨即全面動員。
causeEn: The remote cause lay in the constraints the Treaty of Versailles placed on Germany and in the position of Poland in eastern Europe. When Poland was rebuilt it was given a corridor to the Baltic Sea, which cut Germany off from the Free City of Danzig; Germany, invoking national self-determination and the alleged persecution of minorities, demanded the return of Danzig and the demolition of the corridor, and the question of the German population above the Oder was used again and again as propaganda. The Munich Agreement of 1938 ceded the Sudetenland to Germany; in March 1939 Germany swallowed the rest of Czechoslovakia and created the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia, and then installed in Slovakia a satellite state dependent on Berlin. The treaty Germany concluded with Slovakia on 28 March buried in it an option on Poland should Berlin ever resort to force; on 31 March France and Britain separately delivered notes guaranteeing Polish independence, Britain guaranteed alone in April, and on 12 May the Franco-Polish military convention was signed, promising French intervention shortly after an attack on Poland. The Soviet Union, moved by the Polish corridor and by Soviet strategic interests in eastern Europe, signed the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact with Germany on 23 August, whose secret additional protocol drew the German-Soviet line through eastern Europe and very nearly erased Poland from the map; the Anglo-French-Soviet talks of April to August collapsed, so Poland had a western guarantee and no eastern one. The immediate trigger was the staged Gleiwitz radio incident; in the early hours of 1 September German artillery opened fire on Westerplatte and crossed the frontier, and Poland mobilised in full.
impact: 波蘭戰役是第二次世界大戰的開端，也是歐洲舊秩序崩解的分水嶺。波蘭遭到瓜分：西部併入德國的但澤-西普魯士帝國與波森省，中部成為納粹的「波蘭總督區」，東部由蘇聯接管，維爾納地區轉給立陶宛；約七十萬波蘭軍人被俘，數十萬被押往蘇聯境內的勞改營，其中1939至1940年間在卡廷等地被槍決的波蘭軍官、警員與知識分子達兩萬人上下，卡廷慘案因此成為二戰最沉重的罪行之一。政治上，波蘭政府與國會在流亡中延續，總統拉奇凱維支與後來出任總理的西科爾斯基先後在法國與英國運作；海軍幾乎完整的艦隊與約四萬名人員在英國加入同盟國序列，成為大西洋護航的骨幹，波蘭商船隊亦是世界前列的海運力量。軍事上，「白色方案」雖在三十六天內得手，卻暴露裝甲部隊依賴道路、補給線拉長的弱點，德軍在波蘭大量耗用兵力與車輛，延後了其他方向的準備，也讓德國國內相信歐洲戰事可以速戰速決，兩者共同推高了1940年進攻法國的賭注。國際上，西方盟國的保證成了空談，慕尼黑體系崩潰，歐洲被切成兩大陣營，戰爭自此沿東線與西線同時鋪開。
impactEn: The Polish campaign opened the Second World War and marked the collapse of the old European order. Poland was partitioned: the west was absorbed into the German Reichsgau Danzig-West Prussia and the Province of Posen, the centre became the General Government of the Nazis, the east was taken over by the Soviet Union, and the Vilnius region went to Lithuania. About seven hundred thousand Polish soldiers were taken prisoner and tens of thousands were sent to labour camps inside the Soviet Union, where between 1939 and 1940 some twenty thousand Polish officers, policemen and intellectuals were shot, most notoriously at Katyn, one of the gravest crimes of the war. Politically the Polish government and parliament continued in exile, with President Raczkiewicz and later the prime minister Sikorski working first from France and then from Britain; almost the entire fleet and about forty thousand men joined the Allied order of battle in Britain and formed the backbone of Atlantic convoy escort, and the Polish merchant marine was one of the largest merchant fleets in the world. Militarily Fall Weiss won in thirty-six days but exposed the dependence of armoured formations on roads and the stretching of supply lines; Germany burned a great many troops and vehicles in Poland and delayed its preparations on other fronts, while the German public was convinced that a European war could be won quickly, and the two together raised the stakes of the 1940 attack on France. Internationally the guarantees of the western allies turned out to be empty words, the Munich system collapsed, Europe was cut into two camps, and from then on the war unfolded on an eastern and a western front at once.
result: 到10月6日波蘭國防軍全面停火，戰役以德軍佔領大部、波軍覆亡告終。9月28日德蘇在莫斯科劃定邊界，蘇聯取得明斯克、格羅德諾、比亞韋斯托克與維爾納一帶，東波蘭由蘇聯接管；雷茲-斯米格維隱匿後被捕，波軍各指揮官在華沙郊外接受了投降，華沙於9月27日陷落，赫爾半島守軍在堅持到十月初後經海路撤往格但斯克，驅逐艦「雷霆」號在9月30日被Ju 87俯衝轟炸機擊沉於赫爾灣，「閃電」號在10月1日觸雷後於10月2日自行沉沒。殘存部隊在西方重組：安德斯的摩托化騎兵旅與赫爾部隊組成流亡陸軍，安德斯軍後來成為義大利戰線的支柱，騎兵旅的「索薩博夫斯基」裝甲師在法國作戰。波蘭國家並未滅亡，流亡政府與軍隊在英法繼續運作，1940年6月法國淪陷後轉往英國，戰爭在西方持續到1945年；反觀德國，雖然贏得一場速勝，卻也把兩面作戰的深溝刻進了歐洲的版圖。
resultEn: By 6 October the Polish armed forces had ceased fire everywhere, and the campaign ended with the Germans holding most of the country and the Polish army destroyed. On 28 September Germany and the Soviet Union fixed their new border in Moscow, the Soviet Union taking Minsk, Grodno, Bialystok and the Vilnius region, and eastern Poland passed into Soviet administration; Rydz-Śmigły was caught after going into hiding, the Polish commanders accepted the surrender in the countryside outside Warsaw, the capital fell on 27 September, and the Hel garrison, which had held into early October, was evacuated by sea to Gdańsk. The destroyer Grom was sunk by Ju 87 dive bombers in the Bay of Hel on 30 September, and Błyskawica struck a mine on 1 October and was scuttled on 2 October. The surviving forces were reconstituted in the West: Anders's 10th Motorized Cavalry Brigade and the Hel troops formed the army in exile, the Anders Corps later became a pillar on the Italian front, and Sosabowski's armoured division from the cavalry brigade fought in France. The Polish state itself was not extinguished: the government and army in exile carried on in Britain and France, moved to Britain after the fall of France in June 1940, and the war on that side lasted until 1945. Germany, for its part, had won a quick victory but had cut the deep groove of a two-front war into the map of Europe.
